contract.task_clause:
Use indirect truth tables to determine whether the following argument is valid. If the argument is invalid, choose an option which presents a counterexample. (There may be other counterexamples as well.)
H ≡ (I · ~J)
K ≡ ~H
~(K ⊃ J) / I ≡ J
Option A: Valid
Option B: Invalid. Counterexample when I, H, and K are true and J is false
Option C: Invalid. Counterexample when I and H are true and J and K are false
Option D: Invalid. Counterexample when K is true and I, H, and J are false
